room_rent.display: As opted (limit per day chosen by insured)
room_rent.note: Room rent limit is chosen by the insured at inception and mentioned in Policy Schedule. Proportionate deduction applies if actual room rent exceeds opted limit, except for medicines and consumables.

icu.display: As opted (limit per day chosen by insured)
icu.note: ICU limit is chosen by the insured at inception and mentioned in Policy Schedule. Same proportionate deduction logic applies.

copayment.display: 0% base; 10–20% if treated in higher zone
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay for same-zone treatment. Zone B insured treated in Zone A: 10% co-pay. Zone C insured treated in Zone B: 10%; in Zone A: 20%. OPD section has its own co-pay structure.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, stereotactic radio surgeries, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy each capped at 50% of SI. Cochlear implant capped at 50% of SI. Bariatric surgery and organ donor have separate sub-limits as opted.

deductible.note: Deductible is defined in the policy but no standard deductible is mandated; it is a customer-opted feature mentioned in the Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; can be reduced as opted and mentioned in Policy Schedule. Not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is as opted by insured and mentioned in Policy Schedule; the standard/default is up to 36 months. Reducible via portability credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease waiting period is as opted by insured and mentioned in Policy Schedule; standard maximum is 36 months. Covers arthritis, cataract, hernia, psychiatric illness, bariatric surgery, organ transplant, joint replacement, etc.

maternity.note: Covered under Section 7 if opted. Waiting period as chosen by insured at inception. Limited to 2 living children. Second child covered at a percentage of SI. Ectopic pregnancy covered under main hospitalisation section.

cumulative_bonus.display: As per Policy Schedule (rate/max not specified in wording)
cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative bonus rate and maximum cap are mentioned in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance. Bonus reduces on claim in same proportion as accrued. Alternatively, a 5% No Claim Discount on premium is available.

restoration.display: Once per policy year, 100% SI (unrelated illness only)
restoration.note: Section 10 Sum Insured Refill: 100% of SI refilled once SI is fully exhausted. Triggered only for hospitalisation unrelated to/not arising from earlier claim in same policy period, unless waived by insurer. Number of refills as per Policy Schedule.

pre_hosp.display: As opted (days mentioned in Policy Schedule)
pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation period is chosen by insured at inception and stated in Policy Schedule. Covers consultations, investigations and medicines for the same condition.

post_hosp.display: As opted (days mentioned in Policy Schedule)
post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation period is chosen by insured at inception and stated in Policy Schedule. Alternatively, a lump-sum percentage of claim amount can be opted.

day_care.note: Day care procedures under both accidental and illness hospitalisation sections are covered. Treatment normally taken on OPD basis is excluded.

domiciliary.note: Covered under Section 9 if opted. Requires treatment to continue for at least 3 days. Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inbuilt with Section 1B)
ayush.note: Section 4 is a mandatory in-built cover with Section 1B. Covers inpatient AYUSH treatment up to SI. Only NABH/NQAS-accredited AYUSH hospitals qualify. OPD and preventive/rejuvenation treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Covers harvesting expenses subject to availability of SI under Section 1B. Donor pre/post-hospitalisation covered up to 5% of harvesting claim. Specific waiting period applies.

ambulance.display: As per Policy Schedule limit per hospitalisation
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered under Section 1A/1B subject to limit stated in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance covered under Section 5 if opted. Includes transfer between hospitals if medically necessary.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy (monoclonal antibody injections), intravitreal injections, stereotactic radio surgeries, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, HIFU, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate vaporisation, IONM, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions — all capped at 50% of SI unless specifically agreed otherwise.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items in Annexure A are not payable. Sterilised gloves and a few items payable in specific clinical contexts only.

global_cover.note: Specific exclusion: any treatment received outside India is not covered under this policy.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period except where premium is paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Free-look period is not explicitly mentioned in the policy wording.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Credits for waiting periods, PED, cumulative bonus and moratorium transferable to acquiring insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, STIs, sleep disorders/CPAP, tobacco-related oral/respiratory cancer, stem cell transplant (non-bone marrow), defence operations, sexual disorders

optional_riders.display: Maternity+Newborn, Infertility (IVF/IUI), Organ Donor, Domiciliary, OPD benefit, Daily Hospital Cash, Critical Illness benefit, Cancer benefit, Air Ambulance, Sum Insured Refill, Long Hospitalisation Cash
